title: [2.7] no "import settings" possible because of small display size and no scrolling possible
symptom: On a Jelly Pro phone with small display, the import settings dialog cannot be scrolled, so the user cannot click 'OK' or 'import'. Also, the Confirm button in Objective 3 is only accessible in landscape mode.
cause: The summary dialog in PrefImportSummaryDialog.kt does not allow scrolling on ultra-small screens.
fix: The fix was implemented by osodebailar in pull request #15, which introduced new layout files for small-height and landscape devices with a fixed and scrollable table. The user can also workaround by commenting out lines 46 and 79 in PrefImportSummaryDialog.kt to hide the summary table.
evidence_quote: It is obviously error with summary dialog, which does not allow scrolling on ultra-small screens. I will fix that. In the meantime - hack mentioned above will allow to import prefs.
